expected.gt_note: manually derived: the certificate holder entity name never appears in the request text (the client just names the property, 'Three Lakes and Florida City') -- it is only recoverable by reading the quoted requester's email signature ('Callie McDonald, Director of Project Administration, 790 Marietta St. NW | Atlanta, GA 30318, Tribridgeres.com') and cross-checking the delivered COI, whose filename and holder_text both read 'Tribridge Residential Construction, LLC / 790 Marietta St NW' (ACORD Form 20250113-103038.pdf, verdict=correct).

cases.ground_truth_rationale: The auto-derivation's overlap() check only compares the holder GT NAME against the replay body (falls back to address only when name is empty), so it scored 0.0 overlap here even though the address IS in the body (inside the requester's forwarded signature) -- the entity name 'Tribridge Residential Construction, LLC' is not written anywhere in the text, only inferable from the sig block's company domain (Tribridgeres.com) and the delivered COI. Confirmed by AJF Roofing Inc_Tribridge Residential Construction, LLC.pdf (verdict=correct) delivered the same thread. Classified incomplete because the holder LEGAL NAME (not just an address) is not stated in the request -- a human/model has to look it up, matching how the benchmark treats similar name-not-given cases (e.g. case 13 'hvac').
